title: How to set page parameter to start at 1 instead of 0?
body:
How do I set the trackedParameter for 'page' to start at 1 instead of 0?

so that `/search?q=searchterm&page=0` is instead `/search?q=searchterm&page=1` on the first page?

Basically I want to hook into the method that sets the querystring param, and just visually show it as +1 more than the actual page.

This could be an option using `urlSync`.
